# Code of Conduct

Code of Conduct

Welcome to the Cosmeron community!

Every great project is shaped by the people behind it. We want Cosmeron to be a place where everyone feels welcome to share ideas, learn, ask questions, and contribute in their own way.

This Code of Conduct is here to help us build that kind of community together, with kindness, respect, and a little patience for one another.

Take a moment to read our guidelines. We're glad to have you here!

Check the full information here: [Português](../Docs/pt/Governance/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | [English](../Docs/en/Governance/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | [Español](../Docs/es/Governance/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
